title: Review of c27's ringswim repair claim: on fresh seed 11, 3/3 front-cut cells re-close their ring by +100-140 and swim on beside their exact twins (Supported)
summary: Labkit re-run of world.py on seed 11 with --damage 200:0.4:half (rerun/seed11): cells form from smoothed noise everywhere (sheet.png t=0-600), link rings score rim/core 1.61 and rim/out 6.6 (127/172 individuals) with the wall channel at 2.27 / 7.27, and 107 long-lived tracks move >= 1 body length (max 4.5). labkit's damage target was a small cell (0.52x median) in a crowd: it rounded up (a=0.55) and merged with a neighbour by +600, as did its comparator, so that pack does not decide R. The claim's own branched-twin test (twinrepair.py 11 10000 2500, KEEP_S=1, NPICK=3, front mode; tr_s11/): the 3 picked mature swimmers (areas 251, 335, 337 px) lose 40% of their area and 41-50% of their links; ring closure goes from 0.40, 0.56 and 0.57 just after the cut to >= 0.9 at +100, +120 and +140; the ring scores >= 1.5 in 100% of second-half frames in all 3; area is back at +360, +2400 and +360; and the cut cells move 3.83, 1.95 and 3.63 body lengths against their twins' 0.65, 1.90 and 4.27. None is lost. All three sit in the claim's 'closure >= 0.30 repairs' range, so this seed adds 3/3 to its 17/20.

observations.R: tr_s11/log.txt and twinrepair.png: 3/3 cut cells re-close their ring (closure 0.40-0.57 -> >= 0.9 at +100-140), ring >= 1.5 in 100% of second-half frames, area back at +360 to +2400

seeds_run.result: pass: 3/3 twinrepair cuts repair and swim on; the labkit --damage pack is inconclusive (target merged with a neighbour, as did the comparator)

controls_run.R: tr_s11/: an exact branched undamaged twin for each of the 3 cuts (deterministic dynamics), wound substrate kept

not_checked: the mu=0 and chi=0 controls (I rely on c28's)
verdicts.limitation: One fresh seed and 3 cuts. The track picked by twinrepair follows the largest overlapping piece, and in this crowded world cells also merge: cell 22's cut arm ends at 1059 px (it has absorbed neighbours) and its twin at 70 px, so late-time area and displacement compare different histories, not a clean twin difference. The ring re-closure follows from the wall-adsorption drift of links the cell still holds (chi up grad 4phi(1-phi)), so the ring repair is automatic once links remain; the links are made by the cell's own catalyst, so I count B, and R counts for the rung, scored under mechanism.
